### LKQ Corporation to Release First Quarter 2026 Results on Thursday, April 30, 2026


April 2, 2026


ANTIOCH, Tenn., April 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- LKQ Corporation (Nasdaq: LKQ) will release its first quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, April 30, 2026.


**Conference Call Details**


LKQ will host a conference call and webcast on April 30, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time (7:00 a.m. Central Time) with members of senior management to discuss the Company's results. To access the investor conference call, please dial (800) 715-9871. International access to the call may be obtained by dialing (646) 307-1963. The investor conference call will require you to enter conference ID: 2118690.


**Webcast and Presentation Details**


The audio webcast and accompanying slide presentation can be accessed at ([www.lkqcorp.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=G85SskHLd0AZaVKyP_4oXutiog7lPAuV8Thixh2mtYkNog41gQVLliDttYdz1ivqyITqZ2YK1UvN8xHIepec4yyEUCNKJ1iym97R1KVwgWs=) ) in the Investor Relations section.


A replay of the conference call will be available by telephone at (800) 770-2030 or (609) 800-9909 for international calls. The telephone replay will require you to enter conference ID: 2118690. An online replay of the audio webcast will be available on the Company's website. Both formats of replay will be available through May 7, 2026. Please allow approximately two hours after the live presentation before attempting to access the replay.


**About LKQ Corporation**


LKQ Corporation ([www.lkqcorp.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=G85SskHLd0AZaVKyP_4oXqB1P1pcPuRITSavb2iCk_ZfYnUtihWZFQSREeJJzNPiVeweTvQvWErrt5Pw_5k4Wg==) ) is a leading provider of alternative and specialty parts to repair and accessorize automobiles and other vehicles. LKQ has operations in North America, Europe and Taiwan. LKQ offers its customers a broad range of OE recycled and aftermarket parts, replacement systems, components, equipment, and services to repair and accessorize automobiles, trucks, and recreational and performance vehicles.
